# Engineering Handbook

A practical guide to building reliable services.

## Getting started

Start with a small, observable service. Keep operational knowledge close to the code.

### Prerequisites

- A working development environment
- A reproducible build
- A shared review process

## Verification

Run the checks before publishing changes.

```js
const result = "verified";
```

| Check | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Rendering | Readable content |
| Installation | Portable package |

> Keep the next reader in mind.
